simple.meaning: חֻקָּה (chuqqâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “appointed, custom, manner, ordinance, site, statute.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 105 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 9 more, beginning at Genesis 26:5. Its contexts include family line, covenant, commandment, Torah, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֻקָּה (H2708).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
